description:
Grupo Ultra

A Ultra já nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e também a sociedade.

Todos nós temos o poder de fazer a diferença. E se o mundo está tão diferente por que as academias são todas iguais?

Chegamos para fazer diferente.

Propósito

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades físicas e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

  1. Gerenciar e coordenar as equipes de supervisão e distritais, atividades das unidades de sua gestão.

Sales at TRACTIAN

The Sales team is the driving factor behind revenue at Tractian. We focus on generating new opportunities, acquiring new customers, and building even stronger relationships with our current accounts. Our Enterprise customers are comprised of Fortune 500 companies, such as Hyundai, Bosch, Unilever, P&G, PepsiCo, and others. Tractian's Net Revenue Retention (NRR) is as big as Silicon Valley startups, such as Snowflake (158%) and Twilio (155%), which highlights the stickiness of our products. We make sure that top performers are recognized and over-beating quota.

What you'll do

As an Enterprise Account Manager at Tractian, your primary mission is to exceed revenue targets aggressively. You're in charge of managing and expanding relationships with key enterprise clients, ensuring you understand their business needs and objectives. Your role is pivotal in crafting strategic account plans, leveraging Tractian's suite of products to drive growth and customer success.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and Execute Sales Strategies: Craft and implement effective sales strategies tailored to enterprise-level clients to meet and exceed sales quotas.
  • New Business Development (Hunting): Actively seek out and pursue new sales opportunities within the enterprise segment, expanding Salesforce's client base.
  • Manage Key Accounts (Farming): Nurture and grow relationships with existing enterprise customers, understanding their needs and business objectives.
  • Challenge Selling: Leverage Tractian's product suite to propose tailored solutions that address specific customer challenges and opportunities.
  • Quota Attainment: Consistently achieve and surpass assigned sales quotas, demonstrating effective sales performance and revenue generation.

Requirements

  • Extensive Sales Experience: At least 5-7 years of proven experience in sales, specifically in enterprise-level B2B sales or in a similar technology-driven industry.
  • Proven Track Record in Overachieving Quota: Demonstrable history of consistently exceeding sales targets, particularly in a quota-carrying sales role.
  • Industry Networking: Established network within the relevant industry sectors and the ability to leverage these connections effectively.
  • Advanced Negotiation and Closing Skills: Expertise in managing and closing complex sales cycles.

Bonus Points

  • Deep Understanding of CRM and Cloud Technologies: Strong knowledge of CRM solutions, cloud-based technologies, and the broader SaaS landscape.
  • Bachelor's degree in Federal or State University with extracurricular experience during undergraduate studies (BAJA, EJ, Athletics, FSAE, and sports).
  • English Fluency for dealing with international accounts (C1/C2).
  • Spanish Fluency for dealing with international accounts (C1/C2).

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  • Day off during the week of your birthday.
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Product Design at TRACTIAN

At TRACTIAN, we don’t just create products. We create products, services, and experiences that redefine what customers expect to revolutionize manufacturing. By staying at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends, we ensure our creations are in sync with the demands of modern consumers. What you'll do

As a Product Designer, you will play a key role in all stages of the product development process, from the initial concept to the final delivery to customers.   • Experience in handling multiple complex projects simultaneously.

  • Designing ERP or SaaS products in B2B companies.

description:
About Latitude.sh

Latitude.sh global computing platform was launched in 2019, enabling businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances in different parts of the world.

We are a team of passionate individuals about hardware, software, and network infrastructure looking to build the fastest, easiest-to-use, developer-centric single-tenant Cloud infrastructure. If you share this passion, join our growing team of talented people and help build the future of the Internet.

Summary

At Latitude.sh, the Platform team is responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our products and tools. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be spending your days automating the Latitude.sh platform and building solutions that make it more powerful. Infrastructure Engineers are responsible for building products and tools to automate thousands of bare metal servers distributed across the world. More specifically, you will work with modern IaaC tools and scripting languages to automate the lifecycle of servers on the Latitude.sh platform. This might be a good opportunity if you’re interested in infrastructure automation and how we can bring the experience of the cloud to bare metal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously improve Latitude.sh's operational readiness.
  • Design and develop solutions to automate bare metal lifecycle management using cloud native tools.
  • Collaborate with other teams to implement and manage the infrastructure that supports ours and customer's applications.
  • Escalate and track problems and incidents to the appropriate teams.
  • Identify areas of improvement in Observability, Monitoring, and code.
  • Document all developed solutions and results.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of Linux/Unix systems.
  • Experience with automation tools.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and building and managing containers and container images.
  • A passion for infrastructure as code tools like Terraform.
  • Working knowledge of Git.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python, Go, or Ruby.
  • Knowledge in security and operations best practices.

What do we offer?

  • Contractor (PJ);
  • Paid Time Off;
  • Competitive Compensation;
  • Work Anniversary bonus;
  • Wellhub (former Gympass);
  • Annual Bonus based on company and team performance;
  • Flexible work hours;
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Why Latitude.sh

We're a lean, agile team of passionate professionals who believe in the power of innovation and creative problem-solving. As part of our team, you won't be lost in the crowd – you'll be an essential contributor, making a real impact from day one. Our values at Latitude.sh guide us in all our work and partnerships. We're proud to be an inclusive company, and we welcome all applicants for our open positions, regardless of their background, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, nationality, or disability. If these values speak to you, we'd love for you to become a part of our team.

Gerente de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A)

Responsabilidades

  1. Liderar os processos de planejamento e previsão da empresa, atuando como parceiro de negócios para a equipe de Gestão Local, garantindo uma execução fluida entre as áreas.
  2. Conduzir a projeção (budget) e as respectivas revisões periódicas (forecast) de resultados.
  3. Elaborar o plano de 5 anos.
  4. Analisar as variações do resultado realizado em comparação ao orçado.
  5. Simular cenários e premissas.
  6. Participar ativamente do ciclo de S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning).
  7. Preparar relatórios e apresentações para a Diretoria e para a equipe regional.
  8. Elaborar e simular cenários variados conforme a alteração de premissas estratégicas.
  9. Criar e implantar ferramentas de planejamento financeiro que auxiliem na automatização e otimização de relatórios e processos, sem perder flexibilidade.
  10. Aprimorar as análises de custos diretos e indiretos.
  11. Realizar análises mensais do desempenho financeiro do país e das unidades de negócio, reportando à equipe regional.
  12. Identificar e avaliar financeiramente os riscos e oportunidades de negócios.
  13. Garantir um planejamento preciso, gestão e fechamento anual dos principais indicadores financeiros (GE, Outros Rendimentos / Despesas, P&L Intercompanhias).
  14. Liderar o desenvolvimento de relatórios financeiros no Power BI e garantir a manutenção em tempo hábil.
  15. Co-liderar e desafiar construtivamente as equipes de Contabilidade, Tesouraria e Impostos para assegurar a qualidade das demonstrações financeiras e conformidade fiscal.
  16. Mitigar riscos de conformidade, garantindo a execução de alta qualidade do sistema de controle interno.
  17. Liderar e desenvolver uma equipe forte de parceiros de negócios, apoiada por processos, ferramentas e maneiras de trabalhar padronizados e eficientes.

Qualificações Técnicas

  1. Formação: Não há restrição quanto ao curso de Graduação, que pode ser em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, entre outros. Seria interessante que o profissional tivesse cursado um MBA ou Pós-Graduação na área.
  2. Grande domínio nas atividades de Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A).
  3. Bom nível de proficiência em inglês.

title: Porque se tornar um corretor de seguros
description:
Porque se tornar um corretor de seguros

O papel essencial de um corretor de seguros é agir como intermediário entre indivíduos em busca de seguros e as seguradoras. Seu objetivo principal é encontrar o seguro mais adequado às necessidades do cliente, trazendo o melhor serviço pelo menor preço, representando uma seguradora, e orientá-lo ao longo de todo o processo de contratação e a vigência da apólice.

Qualquer pessoa que preencha certos critérios pode se tornar um corretor de seguros. Não é obrigatório possuir uma formação específica, mas é necessário ser maior de 18 anos, ter concluído o ensino médio e passar no exame de habilitação obrigatório da SUSEP (Superintendência de Seguros Privados) após um curso de capacitação. O candidato deve obter pelo menos 70% de acertos em cada módulo do exame e solicitar registro na SUSEP para exercer a profissão.

Jacques também traz algumas dicas adicionais para se destacar como corretor de seguros:

  1. Desenvolva habilidades de comunicação: Uma comunicação eficaz é crucial para transmitir segurança e confiança ao cliente.
  2. Construa relacionamentos sólidos: Manter um bom relacionamento com o cliente é fundamental para a fidelização e obtenção de novos clientes.
  3. Utilize plataformas de multicálculo: O maior inimigo do corretor de seguros é o tempo, para acelerar o processo de aferição de preços e benefícios plataformas como o SeguroLink é a diferença entre o sucesso e o fracasso de um corretor.

Além da autonomia que recompensa a eficiência e o trabalho do corretor, ainda existem diversas outras vantagens, como a remuneração baseada em comissões, a flexibilidade e a diversidade de atividades que o trabalho envolve.

Em resumo, tornar-se um corretor de seguros, principalmente utilizando ferramentas de multicálculo, não só oferece oportunidades de carreira lucrativas, mas também permite oferecer um serviço de qualidade aos clientes, auxiliando-os na proteção de seus bens e na gestão de riscos.

title: Shipboard Medispa Physician
description:
This position is based on a Cruise Ship.

Education and Experience Requirements

  1. Completed medical education and hold a medical degree from a recognized college or university.
  2. Hold a current valid medical license.
  3. Board certification or similar international certification in Plastic Surgery or Dermatology preferred but not required.
  4. Comfortable with giving presentations/speaking in front of large groups.
  5. Fluency in English.
  6. Strong interpersonal skills.

Reports to: Spa Manager

Job Summary

The Medi-Spa Physician administers cosmetic medical procedures to onboard guests. They must possess the clinical knowledge to administer these procedures safely and effectively and be able to explain accurately all aspects of the products and services to the guests. They must have excellent communication skills and be able to provide aesthetic medical solutions safely and effectively to address the concerns of onboard guests. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to work with The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant, who will assist them with the sales, marketing, and promotional aspects of the position. The Medi-Spa Sales Consultant will also translate for the Medi-Spa Physicians if necessary. The Medi-Spa Physicians are expected to gain knowledge of the spa services and products to cross-promote these services to guests. The Medi-Spa Physician will review and give final approval for all service/treatment plans organized and booked by the Medi-Spa Sales Consultant.

Position Requirements

  1. Possess the ability to work without direct supervision and actively promote the services to the guests.
  2. Work closely with the Medi-Spa Sales Consultant.
  3. Must have enthusiasm and possess excellent customer service skills.
  4. Must be able to give an effective presentation as it relates to medi-spa services.
  5. Enjoy working with people and possess a friendly and outgoing personality.
  6. Excellent communication and listening skills.
  7. Basic computer knowledge.
  8. Must be a team player.

Duties and Responsibilities

  1. Be on time for work, prompt for each appointment.
  2. Provide consistent professional medi-spa services and treatments in accordance with OneSpaWorld’s medi-spa protocols.
  3. Conduct patient follow-up as required.
  4. Be flexible with scheduling, supporting the needs of the spa and guest.
  5. Properly care for equipment and use proper amounts of product/supplies to assist with cost control.
  6. Follow service pricing policy set by OneSpaWorld.
  7. Prior to all services, complete with the guest the Medical Record which must be stored at the completion of each cruise in the Spa Manager’s office or designated place within the spa facilities for a period of 2 years. (3 years on Cunard and P&O).
  8. Cross-promote other spa services.
  9. Uphold the standards of sanitation and sterilization as directed by ship and company policy and procedure.
  10. Properly clean and restock medi-spa treatment room as required.
  11. Manage medical product and supply inventory.
  12. Communicate to management any and all occurrences involving staff or guests in the spa that require attention.
  13. Handle guests’ questions and concerns professionally and courteously.
  14. Provide accurate, appropriate and immediate responses to all requests by guests.
  15. Maintain a positive attitude and contribute toward a quality work environment.
  16. Regularly attend, participate in and support training and staff meetings for the spa.
  17. Required team meetings: embarkation day meetings and sea day team meetings.
  18. Assist in all areas of spa operation as requested by management.
  19. Train new spa staff in medi-spa services/cross-promotion skills – follow up must be carried out to ensure staff are confident with services and promotions.
  20. Follow Medi-Spa Operations Policies.
  21. Email report daily and inventory report with every end of cruise report.

General Guidelines

  1. For all guests, doctors must review the guest consultation information with them prior to the service.
  2. All guests receiving treatments (including complimentary treatments) must complete the required consent forms. Doctors are required to complete a medical record for each guest.
  3. At conclusion of the treatment, review Aftercare Instructions with the guest and provide them with a copy. Conclude by thanking the guest for the opportunity to take care of them. Schedule a follow-up appointment and assist them with scheduling at the front desk.
  4. Clean your room and set up for your next guest.
  5. Do not stand around the front desk between services. Treatment room should look the same at the start and end of every day and between each guest.
  6. The room must be clean, organized, and inviting.

End of Day Checklist

  1. Dispose of open unused needles.
  2. Dispose of Bio-Hazard bag if full.
  3. Take Sharps Container to Medical facility if full.
  4. Sterilize table and countertops.
  5. Fill out inventory control form.
  6. Lock product storage cabinets.
  7. Lock treatment room.
  8. Email daily revenue report to shore side team.

Service Booking Policy

A clean, non-intimidating, state-of-the-art and stress-free environment is not only what we strive to offer our guests, it is the goal for our staff as well. A critical element to the success of our spa is our ability to work together as a team. If we are unable to work seamlessly together, our guest will be the first to notice. It will not only hurt the business of our spa but will affect your individual success in this industry. Following are some policies that we have put in place to help us avoid unnecessary contention:

  1. Medi-Spa Physicians may only be booked for services for which they are qualified to administer.
  2. In some cases, it is impossible to fairly book services if you are not qualified to perform all services.
  3. Medi-Spa Physicians are not allowed to refuse or trade services that they are certified to perform. Guest requests cannot be moved or changed without the Spa Manager’s approval. All staff members are required to perform general duties during their scheduled hours, as directed by the manager onboard. General duties may include, but are not limited to, promotional duties, port cleaning, staff meetings, training and stock inventory. Please be guided by your Spa Manager’s instructions.

Guidelines for Protection and Sanitization (known as ‘GPS’)

  1. Be familiar with OneSpaWorld’s ‘GPS’ to safety.
  2. Understand and practice the required self-screening procedures.
  3. Understand and follow the agreed upon procedures for symptomatic guests or employees.
  4. Understand and adhere to staff and guest Physical Distancing Policy.
  5. Understand and adhere to Staff Personal Hygiene Policy.
  6. Understand and adhere to the Hand Washing Policy.
  7. Arrive at the spa between five and ten minutes prior to assigned shift start time.
  8. Understand proper use and disposal of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for the modality and for handling soiled linen, waste, and chemicals.
  9. Be familiar with the approved disinfecting products available at the spa location including proper use, contact time, disinfection methods and proper storage and handling procedures.
  10. Understand and adhere to the Treatment Room Preparation requirements.
  11. Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable modality and services performed.
  12. Understand and adhere to the Sanitation Policy for the applicable spa area.
  13. Understand the Sanitation Log Policy and complete logs as required.
  14. Understand and adhere to the Retail Product Handling and Transferring Procedure.
  15. Understand and adhere to the Product Sampling Procedure.

title: Solution Architect- Integration
description:
Location: BAL - SEDE

Requisition Number: 33513

Solution Architect - Integration

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for a "Solution Architect - Integration" (Gerente de Arquitetura de Soluções - Integração). In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology, and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster, and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world-class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work.

Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:

  • Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
  • Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative, and efficient
  • Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably

Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Solution Architect - Integration to design robust and scalable integration solutions. This role requires deep technical expertise in integration technologies, particularly MuleSoft or SAP BTP Integration Suite, as well as a strong understanding of API management, messaging systems, and event-driven architecture. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader who can analyze business requirements, design integration architectures, and guide development teams. Excellent communication and collaboration skills are essential to effectively interact with various stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  1. Solution Design: Design and architect integration solutions that meet business requirements, aligning with enterprise architecture principles, security guidelines, and best practices. This includes defining integration patterns, selecting appropriate technologies, and creating detailed specifications.
  2. Technical Expertise: Possess and maintain deep technical knowledge of MuleSoft, SAP BTP Integration Suite, or other relevant integration platforms. Be proficient in API design, development, and management, including API gateways and security. Have a strong understanding of messaging systems (e.g., ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ), event-driven architectures, and microservices.
  3. Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and other stakeholders to elicit and analyze integration requirements. Translate business needs into technical specifications and ensure solutions align with overall IT strategy.
  4. Technical Leadership: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development teams and promote best practices. Lead the evaluation and selection of integration tools and technologies.
  5. Collaboration: Work closely with other architects, developers, infrastructure teams, and security teams to ensure seamless integration and interoperability of systems.
  6. Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, design specifications, and API documentation.
  7. Innovation: Stay current with the latest advancements in integration technologies and explore new approaches to improve integration efficiency, scalability, and security.
  8. Problem Solving: Troubleshoot complex integration issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions.

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  2. Proven experience as a Solution Architect or Senior Integration Engineer.
  3. Strong hands-on experience with MuleSoft, SAP BTP Integration Suite, or other similar iPaaS platforms.
  4. Expertise in API design, development, and management.
  5. Experience with messaging systems, event-driven architecture, and microservices.
  6. Understanding of integration patterns and best practices.
  7. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills.
  8. Fluency in English.

Additional Skills (Beneficial):

  1. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  2. Knowledge of DevOps practices and tools.
  3. Understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF.
  4. Experience with data modeling and database technologies.

Bunge (NYSE: BG) is a world leader in sourcing, processing and supplying oilseed and grain products and ingredients. Founded in 1818, Bunge’s expansive network feeds and fuels a growing world, creating sustainable products and opportunities for more than 70,000 farmers and the consumers they serve across the globe. The company is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri and has 25,000 employees worldwide who stand behind more than 350 port terminals, oilseed processing plants, grain facilities, and food and ingredient production and packaging facilities around the world.

title: Hospitality Assistant Positions at Hollywoodbets
description:
Hospitality Assistant Positions at Hollywoodbets: A Career Opportunity

Introduction

Hollywoodbets, a prominent name in the gambling and casino industry, is extending an exciting opportunity for individuals passionate about hospitality and events. Located in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, the company is seeking three Hospitality Assistants to join their dynamic Purple Team. This article will delve into the details of the position, the qualifications needed, and the potential career growth within this thriving organization.

About Hollywoodbets

Founded in Durban, Hollywoodbets has evolved from modest beginnings into a significant player in the gaming sector, with a presence across Africa and the United Kingdom. The company’s journey is characterized by innovation, resilience, and a commitment to excellence, making it one of South Africa’s most successful brands. As Hollywoodbets continues to expand its global footprint, it offers employees an environment filled with opportunities for professional development and personal growth.

The Role of Hospitality Assistant

Key Responsibilities

The Hospitality Assistant plays a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of hospitality services during events. The primary responsibilities include:

  • Bar Service and Stock Management : Assisting with daily bar operations, including serving clients and managing stock take and reporting. This role requires a thorough understanding of inventory management and catering services.
  • Event Coordination : Working closely with Hospitality Coordinators to oversee the logistics of hospitality suites during sporting events. This includes ensuring that all services run smoothly and efficiently.
  • Reporting and Compliance : Conducting pre- and post-event reporting, including stocktaking and financial tracking, to ensure that all activities align with industry standards and company policies.
  • Supplier and Team Management : Building and maintaining relationships with suppliers and managing the team working during events to ensure a high standard of service delivery.
  • Budget Management : Assisting in obtaining quotes, setting budgets, and monitoring expenditures related to events, ensuring financial discipline.

The role is set in a vibrant and fast-paced environment, ideal for individuals who thrive under pressure and enjoy interacting with clients. The Hospitality Assistants will work at various events, requiring flexibility to adapt to different venues and schedules, often including evenings and weekends.

Qualifications and Experience

Candidates interested in this position should possess:

  • Experience : A minimum of 2-3 years in the events industry, particularly in stadium suites, is preferred. Experience in hosting events is an added advantage.
  • Driver’s License : A valid driver’s license is necessary to facilitate travel to various event locations.

Desirable Qualifications

While not mandatory, having a diploma or degree in event management will enhance a candidate’s profile. Proven experience in managing hospitality in stadium suites can significantly increase the likelihood of securing the role.

Skills and Attributes

Successful candidates will demonstrate a range of skills and attributes, including:

  • Accountability : Taking ownership of tasks and ensuring that all responsibilities are met with diligence.
  • Communication Skills : Excellent verbal and written communication abilities are essential for interacting with clients, suppliers, and team members.
  • Time Management : The ability to prioritize tasks effectively and manage multiple projects simultaneously is crucial in this role.
  • Attention to Detail : Precision in reporting and execution of event logistics ensures a high-quality experience for clients.
  • Market Awareness : Understanding current trends in the hospitality and events industry helps in planning successful events.

Opportunities for Growth

Working with Hollywoodbets opens the door to numerous opportunities for professional development. The company emphasizes the importance of employee growth through:

  • Training Programs : Hollywoodbets offers various training initiatives to enhance skills and knowledge in hospitality and event management.
  • Career Advancement : As the company expands, there are numerous opportunities for employees to advance their careers within the organization.
  • Innovative Environment : Being part of a forward-thinking team allows for creativity and the implementation of new ideas, fostering a culture of innovation.

Conclusion

The Hospitality Assistant positions at Hollywoodbets represent a unique opportunity for individuals eager to contribute to a leading brand in the gambling and hospitality sectors. With a commitment to excellence and a vibrant work environment, Hollywoodbets not only seeks to enhance its services but also aims to invest in its employees’ growth and success.

If you believe you have the passion and qualifications to excel in this role, now is the time to apply and join a team that is ready to reach for the stars.

title: Software Engineer II Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Carta develops purpose-built software that transforms traditional accounting into a powerful growth engine.

Carta’s world-class fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under management in venture capital and private equity.

Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is setting a new standard as the end-to-end platform for private markets. Our best-in-class solution for fund management seamlessly integrates investor and portfolio company insights via a suite of tools designed ground-up to support the strategic impact of the fund CFO.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer-facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third-party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event-driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You'll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we're building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here. Here are some of the teams we’re hiring for:

  • Transactions - The Transactions team is dedicated to simplifying and accelerating equity liquidity for private companies. We help issuers provide liquidity opportunities through tender offers, enabling employees to unlock the value of their equity awards. Our mission is to enhance transparency and support stakeholders in navigating complex financial decisions for better financial outcomes.
  • Investor Access - The Investor Access team enhances the connection between investors and their portfolio companies by providing timely and accurate access to investment data. We work closely with leading investment firms to streamline data management and ensure security, all while delivering a seamless user experience. Our commitment to innovation and transparency aims to set new standards in investor relations, supporting informed decision-making and fostering trust within the investment community.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional, and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross-functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take-home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list). Finally, you'll have back-to-back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento de Compras - RP 15381 (15381)
description:
Sistema Fiep é sinônimo de fortalecimento da indústria.
Trabalhamos de forma integrada, visando ser referência nacional no desenvolvimento industrial, no apoio ao associativismo e no atendimento eficiente.

Esta é a nossa missão: Promover, representar e defender a indústria paranaense, em busca da melhor competitividade e desenvolvimento sustentável.

Para você que deseja contribuir com o nosso propósito, de transformar o Paraná no melhor lugar para a indústria no Brasil, esta vaga pode ser sua!

Qual é a posição?

Quais são os desafios e as principais responsabilidades?

  • Coordenar a gestão de demandas de aquisições no Sistema Fiep, identificando as necessidades junto às áreas e avaliando a necessidade de realocação de pessoas conforme o volume de demandas;
  • Promover a atualização e adesão ao Plano Anual de Compras das áreas, utilizando planilhas de gestão e cronogramas para organizar aquisições planejadas e renovações de contratos, garantindo a continuidade dos negócios;
  • Atualizar e monitorar a lista de investimentos das áreas de compras, alinhando-se com a planilha aprovada pela Instituição para atingir a meta de investimentos do Sistema Fiep;
  • Realizar treinamentos contínuos para o time, promovendo o desenvolvimento de uma equipe de alta performance;
  • Controlar o orçamento da coordenação de planejamento de compras, avaliando necessidades e acompanhando sua execução para garantir o uso adequado dos recursos financeiros;
  • Desenvolver estratégias eficazes de compras para atender às demandas do negócio, sempre alinhadas aos objetivos financeiros e operacionais da empresa;
  • Negociar e revisar contratos com fornecedores, tanto globais quanto locais, garantindo as melhores condições de preço, prazo e qualidade;
  • Garantir a inserção de requisições de compras das áreas de negócio nos sistemas informatizados;
  • Acompanhar todo o ciclo de compras, desde a demanda das áreas até a entrega final do produto ou serviço;
  • Gerir a distribuição da demanda dos chamados de Compras, assegurando o fluxo adequado dos processos;
  • Controlar os saldos de compras simplificadas das unidades de negócio entre outras atividades.

Quais são os principais requisitos?

  • Desejável formação em Administração, Engenharias, Ciências Contábeis entre outras;
  • Especialização na área será um diferencial;
  • Desejável habilidade em desenvolvimento e gestão de pessoas;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em planejamento de demandas de compras;
  • Candidatos Internos, atender aos critérios de elegibilidade NG 0077 (4.5.4).

Fique por dentro de alguns detalhes sobre esta oportunidade:

Local de trabalho da vaga: Senai Sede (Avenida Candido de Abreu, 200 - Centro Cívico).

Horário: 08:00 às 12:00 e 13:00 às 17:00 (Segunda a sexta-feira) 40 horas semanais.

Etapas do processo seletivo (todas eliminatórias):

Triagem RH - Triagem do Gestor - Solicitação documentos comprobatórios - Entrevista RH - Entrevista de Validação - Admissão.

Ficou interessado? Candidate-se e boa sorte!

O prazo para inscrição neste processo seletivo é do dia 08/11/2024 a 18/11/2024.

Essa vaga também se destina a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) ou reabilitados(as).

Este processo seletivo tem validade de 24 meses, podendo ocorrer o aproveitamento de candidatos aprovados em novas oportunidades deste mesmo perfil, seguindo a ordem de classificação.

title: Application Sr Analyst
description:
Grow your career with us

Here at Averis, our common purpose is to improve lives by developing resources sustainably. Our people are crucial in helping us to realise our vision to be one of the best Global Business Solution (GBS) organizations to support our customers in creating value for the Community, Country, Climate, Customer, and Company.

Role Summary:
Acting in SAP implementation projects with development of new solutions and maintenance of existing systems, subsystems, and interfaces, carrying out the technical feasibility study, technical knowledge to identify, evaluate and develop processes that meet business requirements and aligned architecture definitions to the standard of the business group.

Responsibilities:

You are on a journey to join an exciting Company and be part of our success story. Here we will equip you with the know-how and experience that will define your growth. In this role that you are about to embark on, you are required to carry out the following responsibilities:

  • Understand project needs, raise and document technical requirements, working on problem-solving and building new solutions in collaboration with the Applications, Infrastructure, and Global Team teams;
  • Create or review technical and functional documentation of processes and new solutions to ensure the assertive development of solutions;
  • Ensure that SAP ERP system implementations and changes and complementary solutions meet the previously established requirements, following the change management governance and providing post Go Live support;
  • Monitor the progress of services provided by external suppliers for project implementation and problem-solving, keeping in constant contact with internal customers, suppliers, and global IT team;
  • Development and maintenance of products in SAP ECC, creation and adjustments in RFCs, BADIs, BAPIs, Classes in ABAP, Smart forms, SAPScript, enhancement and/or customization of objects in SAP, creation of Web Application with WebDynpro, application of notes by snote and manual steps, interface configurations and PI/PO integrations;
  • Development and/or correction and adjustments to existing programs;
  • Perform monitoring and updates of versions in the SAP ERP system and complementary solutions, working on approvals and tests to achieve quality in deliveries;
  • Seek opportunities to improve existing systems and integrations;
  • Know and comply with IT and business policies.

Requirements:
To be successful in this role, it is recommended that you should have the following skills and qualifications:

  • A degree in the related job field.
  • Those with 1 to 2 years of working exposure or experience in a similar role will have an advantage but not essential.
  • Willing to relocate to the job location.

When you send us your resume and personal details, it is deemed you have provided your consent for us to keep or store your information in our database. All the information you have provided is only used for the recruitment process. Averis will only collect, use, process or disclose personal information where and when allowed to under applicable laws.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. We endeavour to respond to every applicant. However, if you receive no response from us within 60 days, please consider your application for this specific position unsuccessful. We may contact you in the future if there are opportunities that match your qualifications and experience. Thank you for considering a career with Averis.

WE ARE AVERIS

The Leading Global Business Services and Solutions Provider

Established in 2006, Averis offers services and solutions that cater to all our customers’ business requirements, such as Finance & Accounting, Human Resources, IT Ops & Project Services, Digital Services, Shipping Documentation, Corporate Services, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Change Management.

We’re also certified partners of the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA), and CPA Australia.

We’re currently headquartered in Malaysia and have recently expanded globally to Brazil, Dubai, and Indonesia. To date, we support our customers across various industries that range from manufacturing to RSPO certified palm, and energy. Our customers are headquartered in Singapore, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, Brazil, as well as Canada.

A Rewarding Career Awaits You

We strive to provide Averians the best! When you’re part of the A-team, you’ll get to enjoy these competitive perks.

  • Overseas postings and short-term secondments

  • Reward and recognition awards
  • Exciting recreational and employee engagement activities such as cultural celebrations, sporting matches, artistic workshops, monthly themed celebrations, annual dinners, CSR initiatives, and more
  • Competitive leave benefits
  • Supported examination leave

title: Graphic Designer at Fella Health — (Remote, US Hours, $25k - $32k/yr total comp inc equity)
description:
About Fella Health

Fella Health helps middle-aged men live 10 years longer.

We are the telemedicine clinic for bigger guys, worldwide. We use medical weight loss treatment to solve our fellas' most pressing healthcare need, then remain a fella's core healthcare provider for the rest of their life - focused on men's health, longevity, mental health, and primary care.

We will have served 1 million fellas by the end of 2026, and 10 million fellas by the end of 2028.

Our mission is to solve male obesity worldwide, by accelerating the take-up of GLP-1s in middle-aged men. From this, we’ll become the world’s leading men’s health brand.

We’ve grown >150x since Sept 2022, grown >10x since Nov 2023, and are strongly cashflow positive . We have expanded our state coverage to >95% of US population, have started to expand our clinical protocol beyond weight (e.g. testosterone), and are eyeing up international expansion.

We're still a young startup and are moving quickly. We have a long way to go. This is still Day 1.

You can read more about working at Fella here:

We're backed by top healthcare & consumer investors:

  • Y Combinator

  • Global Founders Capital

  • AngelList Early Stage Fund

  • BrandProject

  • The founders of Indeed, Curative, Alan, Kaia Health, Vouch Insurance, Not Boring

The opportunity as Graphic Designer

Fella Health is building a world-class team.

As a Graphic Designer at Fella Health, you’ll work closely with our Creative Lead to deliver visually compelling and high-converting static ads for our DTC campaigns.

You'll start by analyzing all of our existing static ads to understand what has been performing well and reviewing all our design elements to explore how we can optimize and elevate our visual content performance.

Over time, you'll develop high-performing static ads to be displayed across various platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and more, continuously analyzing data, testing new ideas, and iterating on the designs to improve their performance and help us achieve our goal of serving 10 million fellas by the end of 2028.

This is a full-time remote role.

You'll report directly to our Creative Lead (André Andrade ), as well as work closely with our Media Buyer.

Key Responsibilities

Straight away:

Design and optimize visual content :

  • Take over the creation and finalization of static ads for various campaigns, ensuring high-quality outputs that align with brand standards and campaign goals.

  • Analyze the performance of visual content across different platforms, using metrics to assess engagement and ROI. Provide insights to inform future design strategies.

  • Conduct A/B tests on different graphic elements, styles, and other variables to identify what drives the best performance. Apply these learnings to optimize future designs.

  • Work closely with internal creative teams to ensure graphic content is aligned with overall campaign objectives and brand messaging. Provide feedback and guidance to improve visual output.

In the near future:

  • Innovate with new design trends and platforms : Stay ahead of design trends and experiment with new styles and platforms (e.g., social media, print, digital ads) to reach and engage with the target audience effectively. Be an early adopter of emerging design technologies and techniques.

Need to Have

  • DTC Designer Mastery: You have 4+ years of proven experience as a Graphic Designer, with a strong portfolio showcasing examples of static ads and proven experience as a Graphic Designer for a DTC brand.

  • Software proficiency: You are an expert at Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc). You have a strong understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design.

  • Data-driven optimization : You are great at analyzing static ads performance data, A/B testing and applying data-driven learnings to improve static ads.

  • Entrepreneurial drive : You’re creative, highly organized, and detail-oriented, a great communicator and are excited by the opportunity to build something new and impactful.

Nice to Have

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts or other related field.

  • Experience: You’ve previously worked in a DTC company in the healthcare industry.

Our cultural standards

These are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members at Fella:

  • Belief in the mission — we will have served 10 million fellas by the end of 2028 and we transform the life of most fellas who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our fellas and are dedicated to the mission.

  • Bulldozing barriers — the world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves.

  • Unwavering integrity — we are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can’t look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  • Enduring frugality — we are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. We spend our cash wisely & carefully - in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  • Do what is needed — speed is critical and often the solutions we need are messy. We are comfortable moving quickly, taking on gritty work, and owning projects from noticing the problem to delivering the outcome.

  • Distaste for incompetence — we’re highly capable. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence. We’re obsessed with our role, with a commitment to compounding self-improvement.

  • Commitment to candor — we believe in open communication and transparency. We are clear & caring communicators, welcoming feedback.

  • Only the paranoid survive — the road of expansion is bumpy. We are not fair weather sailers; we embrace the storms. However much we’ve already done, however far we’ve already come — all our work is still ahead of us.

  • Keep your head down — we’re boring people doing exciting work. We don’t chase short-term status: we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

“You just build a amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the fella. Give the fella massively more value than you take.” — a poetic extract from one of our advisors

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation : $25k - $32k/yr total comp (salary + equity)

  • Healthcare : comprehensive medical insurance

  • Vacation : PTO with a yearly minimum (≥2wks/yr + local national holidays)

  • Remote : our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely

  • Personal development : budget for books, courses, coaching

  • Personal wellness : budget for gym, health apps

  • Coaching : free biweekly health coaching

  • Equipment : Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

  1. Apply at the job board you are in or directly into Ashby.

description:
Oficina capacita pessoas com deficiência para elaborar projetos culturais em MS

Com o intuito de capacitar pessoas com deficiência para a criação, estruturação e execução de projetos culturais inclusivos, a FCMS (Fundação de Cultura de Mato Grosso do Sul) e a Setesc (Secretaria de Estado de Turismo, Esporte e Cultura), em parceria com o programa Inclui MS, promoverá a “Oficina de Elaboração de Projetos Culturais para Pessoas com Deficiência” no dia 18 de novembro. As inscrições estão abertas (clique para acessar ) .

A iniciativa busca fomentar a participação ativa de pessoas com deficiência na cena cultural local, promovendo o uso da Libras (Língua Brasileira de Sinais) e audiodescrição como práticas padrão em eventos culturais. A oficina é destinada a pessoas com deficiência, incluindo artistas, produtores culturais e gestores de espaços culturais, que desejam contribuir para o fortalecimento do cenário cultural inclusivo.

A atividade contará com 30 vagas limitadas, será gratuita e acontecerá no MIS (Museu da Imagem e do Som), localizado no 3º andar do Memorial da Cultura “Apolônio de Carvalho”, em Campo Grande, das 19h às 21h, com acessibilidade em Libras e audiodescrição.

A capacitação visa ampliar o acesso e a participação de pessoas com deficiência no cenário cultural de Mato Grosso do Sul. Em consonância com a Lei Aldir Blanc, que destina 5% dos recursos para ações afirmativas voltadas a esse público, a oficina procura democratizar o acesso à produção e fruição artística, abrangendo tanto áreas urbanas quanto rurais e periféricas. A capacitação surge em resposta às dificuldades enfrentadas por muitos produtores e artistas com deficiência, que encontram obstáculos para elaborar projetos devido à falta de informação e acessibilidade.

Serviço

Data: segunda-feira, 18 de novembro de 2024
Horário: 19h às 21h
Local: MIS – Memorial da Cultura “Apolônio de Carvalho” – Av. Fernando Corrêa da Costa, 559, 3º andar – Centro, Campo Grande (MS)
Entrada gratuita com vagas limitadas (30 no total)

BERTIN TECHNOLOGIES est un groupe industriel européen de l’instrumentation qui conçoit et fabrique des composants, des équipements et des systèmes de mesure, d’observation et de détection pour des applications critiques et scientifiques.

Rejoignez nos 700 collaborateurs pour participer à notre développement ambitieux !

Avec un chiffre d'affaires de 132 millions d’euros en 2023 , nous répondons au plus près des besoins de nos clients au travers de nos 17 implantations en France et à l'international (Allemagne, Italie, Royaume-Uni, Suède, Finlande, Etats-Unis, Singapour...). Nous intervenons à la fois sur des projets de recherche et développement pour le compte de nos clients et sur des projets de développement de nos propres lignes de produits. Chaque jour, nous poursuivons les avancées technologiques dans les domaines du Nucléaire, de la Défense, du Spatial, des Grands Instruments Scientifiques, des Sciences de la Vie et de la Santé.

Notre mission : répondre aux enjeux de notre monde et participer à l’effort collectif de création d’une industrie durable et d’une souveraineté européenne de nos nations à travers la sécurité des hommes et des nations, la protection de l’environnement, la sécurisation de la production d’énergie décarbonée, et l’amélioration de la connaissance scientifique.

Acteur majeur de l'innovation, Bertin Technologies vous propose de prendre part à une aventure technologique initiée en 1956. Vous y exprimerez vos compétences et votre personnalité au sein d'une structure souple, dynamique et ambitieuse qui valorise l’humain et l’associe à la réussite de la société. Quelle que soit votre expertise, vous trouverez chez nous un environnement de travail stimulant et tourné vers l'excellence !

Pour nous aider à atteindre nos objectifs de performance, notre ambition se poursuit et nous renforçons nos équipes alors rejoignez-nous et devenez notre nouveau Technicien d’Intervention sur site (H/F) !

Soyez l'artisan de votre poste ! Vos principales missions seront évolutives en fonction de vos expériences d'hier et de vos envies pour demain. title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Career Opportunities with Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

A great place to work.

Careers At Community Health Centers of the Central Coast

Share with friends or Subscribe!

Are you ready for new challenges and new opportunities?

Join our team!

Current job opportunities are posted here as they become available.

Subscribe to our RSS feeds to receive instant updates as new positions become available.

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine

Wage Range that the Company Expects to Pay: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly

SUMMARY

Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results the Physician provides primary healthcare services for Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC), and to perform related work as required.

It is the primary purpose of CHC to provide the highest quality of total care possible to the patient population it serves. Such a level of quality depends ultimately on the staffs desire and ability to work together, individually, and as a team. The employee is expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic at all times.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties assigned by the Chief Medical Officer include, but are not limited to, the following activities and may be adjusted based on patient and clinic medical service requirements:

Secures and evaluates a patient's health history and records findings in a systematic, accurate and succinct manner.

Performs a physical assessment and is able to discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.

Provides routine physical examinations, diagnostic services and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.

Adheres to the highest standards of medical ethics at all times.

Assures quality of care for all patients.

Shares on-call duties, when indicated, with other members of the medical staff.

Elicits and records information about patient's medical history.

Examines patient to determine general physical condition.

Orders or executes various tests, analyses, and diagnostic images to provide information on patient's condition.

Analyzes reports and findings of tests and of examination, and diagnoses condition.

Administers or prescribes treatments and drugs.

Inoculates and vaccinates patients to immunize patients from communicable diseases.

Advises patients concerning diet, hygiene, and methods for prevention of disease.

Reports births, deaths, and outbreak of contagious diseases to governmental authorities.

Refers patients to medical specialist or other practitioner for specialized treatment.

Conducts physical examinations to provide information needed for admission to school, consideration for jobs, or eligibility for insurance coverage.

Assists the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies, evaluating existing policies and developing changes in policies as necessary; designing, implementing, and evaluating education programs for patients and staff.

Shares supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required.

Works within privileges and protocols as established by the Chief Medical Officer.

Participates in committees as requested by the Chief Medical Officer.

Demonstrates adherence to and observes all safety policies and procedures, inclusive of infection control rules and regulations.

Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of the patients served (infants, pediatrics, adolescent, adults or geriatrics).

Demonstrates knowledge of domestic violence, child, and dependent and elder abuse protocols.

Maintains and adheres to HIPAA, confidential and privileged communications (patient, employees, and corporation).

Participates in patient population management as it relates to clinical services while taking into account cultural diversity and local resources.

Participates in the team member's care coordination by providing follow up phone calls post hospital discharge, Assists the patient with follow up appointments within the recommended time frames and gather data from recent hospital admissions to facilitate follow up.

Understands the role in self-management support by developing a relationship with high risk clients and anticipate what needs they may encounter. Develop the ability to refer to an RN when clinical judgment is in question.

Develop communication skills with all members of the team both internal and external, by first being a patient advocate and use the available resources to facilitate care. Coordinate with the Care Team (PCP, RN, Health Educator, LCSW, Director of Nursing and/or Chief Medical Officer) to ensure appropriate services are arranged for the patient in order for them to meet their goals.

Understand the role in the quality improvement process which may include meetings, data collection and charge auditing. Use Evidence Based Practice guidelines to assist with disease management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

Medical Doctor Degree (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school. Completion of a residency training program in the field Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Board Certified or board eligibility required. Maintains current knowledge in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics through continuing medical education, participation in local and national medical societies.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret the most complex documents. Ability to respond effectively to the most sensitive inquiries or complaints. Bilingual (English and Spanish) ability to speak, read, write Spanish desirable.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to interpret bar graphs.

REASONING ABILITY

Authoritative knowledge of the principles, practice and techniques of family-centered medicine. Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Possession of current unrestricted and valid License - Physician and Surgeon or equivalent from Medical Board of California. Board Certified/Eligible Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN or Pediatrics, required. Possession of current unrestricted and valid DEA license, Advanced Cardio Life Support (ACLS) for FP/IM, Pediatric

Advanced Life Support (PALS) card for PEDS; and Basic Life Support (BLS-C) card for all specialties.

Annual health examination; annual TB skin test clearance or biannual chest x-ray, and up to date immunizations for health care workers at time of hire and annually thereafter.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Must be willing to have a flexible work schedule that may include late evenings and weekends, and be able to travel to other clinic sites or locations as needed.

Nossos Shoppers são as pessoas mais importantes da nossa operação, pois são eles quem levam para os clientes toda a experiência que é comprar na Daki. Desde a seleção do produto até aquela organizada no estoque, para garantir que tudo que o cliente pediu chegue com a qualidade que oferecemos, e claro, curtindo cada momento dessa experiência!

Responsabilidades:

  1. Realizar a montagem dos pedidos (Selecionar os produtos, embalar, garantindo aquela experiência de compra incrível para o nosso cliente);

  3. Vale Alimentação;
  4. Créditos Desconta Aki;
  5. Adicional Noturno (Se necessário pelo Horário);
  6. Assistência odontológica.

Sobre a Daki:

Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.

E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!

Aí criamos a Daki. :) Somos o app de delivery mais rápido do Brasil. Entregamos mais de 1000 produtos na sua porta em minutos! Simples, intuitivo e super rápido - para você ter tempo de desfrutar o melhor da sua vida sem precisar perder tempo indo ao supermercado.

Nossos produtos foram cuidadosamente selecionados para atender aos prazeres do dia-a-dia e também às necessidades de uma vida agitada. Temos da cerveja gelada ao carregador de celular, e estamos sempre à procura de inovações que entreguem experiências ainda melhores para a nossa exigente clientela.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que compartilhem essa visão de um mundo mais simples, tecnológico e com foco no cliente, e também que transbordem energia para tirar esse sonho do papel. Se você se identificou, esse é um bom sinal!

Nossos valores:

Na Daki, acreditamos que é possível revolucionar o mercado sem abrir mão do que é mais importante: as pessoas. Cuidar de você e do outro é essencial para manter um ambiente de trabalho leve, onde todos se sintam seguros, física e psicologicamente.

Colaborar é a chave para o sucesso. Estamos sempre atentos às necessidades e objetivos de todos, porque sabemos que o nosso propósito final é comum: encantar nossos clientes!

Entregar do Jeito Certo significa agir com integridade e ética, enfrentando desafios de frente para garantir a melhor qualidade, experiência e valor em tudo o que fazemos.

Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.

Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.

E, claro, também precisamos Curtir o caminho. Celebramos cada conquista – das pequenas até as grandes – com brilho nos olhos, aprendendo com os erros e criando espaço para aquilo que mais importa na vida.

Se você se identifica com essa forma de trabalhar e viver, então você encontrou o seu lugar. Seja bem-vinda(o) à nossa página de Carreiras!

title: Waynes Warbler Lead Technician
description:
The Center for Conservation Biology (CCB) is a research and education organization at William & Mary and Virginia Commonwealth University dedicated to bird conservation. The CCB’s mission, through all of its diverse programs, is to provide the global community with the information needed to drive thoughtful, science-based conservation, educate and train the next generation of conservation scientists, and make lasting contributions to the natural world through critical thinking, innovation, and ground-breaking research.

Position Summary

The Center for Conservation Biology is seeking a Crew Lead to conduct Wayne’s black-throated green warbler surveys, nest searching and monitoring, and lead a crew of 2-3 technicians in southeast Virginia from March 03-June 30, 2025.

Wayne’s warbler is a genetically unique form of black-throated green warbler (S. virens virens) that occurs in a disjunct breeding range along coastal swamps in the mid-Atlantic region. This project provides an opportunity to better understand Wayne’s warbler range and abundance in Virginia as well as describing nests and other demographic information that is not well documented.

The field site for the project will be areas surrounding the Great Dismal Swamp National Wildlife Refuge (GDSNWR). Surveys will occur from the road and by boat, but the candidate will venture into swampy habitats when nest searching, monitoring, and attempting to capture birds. Housing will be provided at USFWS bunkhouse at the GDSNWR and private housing near Chesapeake Virginia. Pay is 18.00/hour (~$2,688/month).

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience identifying eastern songbirds by sight and sound.
  • Ability to navigate using GPS and use a standardized survey protocol.
  • Experience with mist netting and/or banding.
  • Physically capable of accomplishing the work and willing to work early mornings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a field crew.
  • Experience operating a chainsaw.
  • Experience with canoes, kayaks, or motorized boats.
  • Experience with mist nets and bird banding.

Conditions of Employment

  • This position requires driving or riding in cars and boats to field sites.
  • The ability to work outdoors daily, and at times, under rigorous conditions.
  • The ability to perform physically strenuous duties and lift/carry 50 pounds.
  • A valid driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
  • This is a non-exempt position, eligible for overtime.

William & Mary values diversity and invites applications from underrepresented groups who will enrich the research, teaching, and service missions of the university.

Crossfit is my favourite sport in the world, and I usually like to start my day off with it to get ready for work. In my spare time, I like to travel to my hometown to visit my parents and brothers. They have a small brewery, and we brew beer together. My favourite is the stout beer with bacon flavour - it is a family special!

What is your background?

I started as a trainee in Gerdau, a steel mill company located in the countryside of Brazil. I was in charge of shipping, mainly working on shipments of coal to USA, Australia and Canada. Then, I worked as a broker in Maersk Broker and moved to London and Buenos Aires where my focus area was ECSA. Later, I moved back to Brazil to join NORDEN as assistant chartering manager.

What does your typical workday look like?

Today, we are more connected through cell phones and apps. So, my day usually starts off by checking my pop-up messages and talking with my colleagues in Copenhagen, who are 4-5 hours ahead from us depending on the time of the year. I work out at 6:30 a.m. every day and get in at the office at 9 a.m. where I spend most of my day talking with colleagues, brokers and clients. Chartering is a very dynamic job that requires us to be on top of the market in order to make the right decisions. The interesting thing is that each day is different!

What is the best part of your job?

The personal contact we have with our clients and brokers. To understand their needs and particularities are very interesting and important as NORDEN is involved in almost all types of commodities in dry cargo. In addition, NORDEN has employees of many nationalities, resulting in a very rich working environment.

Why did you choose NORDEN?

NORDEN is a well-established company with a solid background which allows the employee to have his/her own voice. The company supports growth, and most heads of P&L'sand overseas offices have been insourced. NORDEN is also a company ahead of its time because they recognise and reward talent and performance and supports more women in shipping.

title: Seduc-SP abre inscrições para contratação de professores na categoria O
description:
Seduc-SP abre inscrições para contratação de professores na categoria O

A Coordenadoria de Gestão de Recursos Humanos da Secretaria da Educação do Estado de São Paulo (Seduc-SP) anunciou a abertura das inscrições para docentes classificados no processo seletivo simplificado da Vunesp, realizado em 5 de junho de 2024, que se destina à atribuição inicial de classes e aulas para o ano letivo de 2025, conforme a legislação vigente.

NORMAS PARA CONTRATAÇÃO TEMPORÁRIA

O processo seletivo segue as normas estabelecidas pela Lei Complementar n º 1.093, de 16 de julho de 2009, que regulamenta a contratação por tempo determinado, conforme o inciso X do artigo 115 da Constituição Estadual.

As inscrições devem ser realizadas exclusivamente pela plataforma Secretaria Escolar Digital (SED), disponível no site: sed.educacao.sp.gov.br, seguindo o cronograma abaixo:

  1. 21/11 a 01/12/2024 – Período de inscrição
  2. 21/11 a 26/11/2024 – Interposição de recursos
  3. 21/11 a 27/11/2024 – Análise de recursos pela Unidade Escolar
  4. 21/11 a 28/11/2024 – Análise de recursos pela Diretoria de Ensino
  5. 6/12/2024 – Divulgação da classificação final

Atenção: recursos só podem ser apresentados antes da confirmação da inscrição, acompanhados de justificativas e documentos comprobatórios. Recursos enviados após a confirmação não serão aceitos.

Durante o processo de inscrição, os professores deverão:

  • Confirmar seus dados pessoais;
  • Informar tempo de experiência no magistério;
  • Declarar raça/cor e, se aplicável, condição de pessoa com deficiência (PCD);
  • Atualizar ou confirmar sua formação acadêmica;
  • Indicar interesse no Itinerário Formativo Técnico Profissional;
  • Sinalizar interesse em participar de Programas ou Projetos da Secretaria;
  • Optar pela carga horária desejada;
  • Declarar interesse em atuar no Programa Ensino Integral (PEI);

Os docentes que desejarem se credenciar no PEI devem cumprir os seguintes requisitos:

  • Frequência mínima de 90% entre 15 de fevereiro e 31 de agosto de 2024;
  • Não ter acumulado 60 ou mais faltas-aulas no período mencionado.

A ausência de inscrição dentro do prazo impedirá a participação no processo de atribuição inicial de classes e aulas 2025.

Para mais informações, acesse o Diário Oficial do Estado de São Paulo.

description:

Home » Grupo Edson Queiroz abre inscrições para Programa Trainee 2025

Novidades

Com duração de um ano, o programa oferece oportunidades para recém-formados, com job rotation entre os negócios e desenvolvimento acelerado na sede do grupo em Fortaleza (CE)

Fortaleza, novembro de 2024 — O Grupo Edson Queiroz (GEQ), uma das maiores holdings multissetoriais do Brasil, anuncia a abertura das inscrições para o seu Programa de Trainee de 2025. O GEQ busca jovens talentos com potencial de liderança, disposição para inovar e interesse por desafios.

O Programa Trainee GEQ 2025 ficará aberto para inscrições até o dia 16 de dezembro, oferecendo 32 vagas para atuar na sede do grupo, localizada em Fortaleza (CE). Com duração de 12 meses, o programa inclui job rotation entre os diferentes negócios, mentorias com profissionais da alta gestão e a elaboração de projetos estratégicos. Durante essa jornada de desenvolvimento, os trainees terão o acompanhamento contínuo da equipe de Recursos Humanos e de gestores do grupo.

As vagas estão distribuídas em diversas áreas, como:

  • Marketing, Comercial e Vendas;
  • Industrial e Manutenção;
  • Engenharia e Qualidade;
  • Comunicação e Inovação Digital;
  • Soluções Energéticas.

Para se candidatar, os interessados devem ter concluído o bacharelado ou licenciatura entre agosto de 2022 e agosto de 2024 em cursos como Administração, Engenharias, Ciências Econômicas, Ciências Contábeis, Psicologia, Pedagogia, Direito, Comunicação e Tecnologia. Além disso, é necessário possuir domínio em inglês, bons conhecimentos de informática e disponibilidade para residir em Fortaleza.

As inscrições para o Programa podem ser realizadas diretamente pela plataforma Cia de Talentos. Todas as etapas do processo serão realizadas de forma online, com exceção da etapa final, que ocorrerá presencialmente na capital cearense.

Sobre o Grupo Edson Queiroz – Desde 1951, o GEQ se faz presente nos mais diversos momentos da vida dos brasileiros por meio de um portfólio diversificado de marcas e produtos de segmentos variados. O Grupo consolidou uma cultura de pioneirismo e desenvolvimento de grandes negócios, empregando cerca de 10 mil colaboradores e guiando suas decisões nos princípios éticos que baseiam todas as suas relações.

Sobre a empresa

A TECNOFAST é uma empresa brasileira de capital fechado com sede em Novo Hamburgo, no estado do Rio Grande do Sul (RS). A empresa foi constituída há 43 anos e atua com a marca própria AIRFIX (marca registrada) e marca associada PREBENA (Alemanha) no mercado nacional brasileiro de fixadores industriais.

O negócio é a produção de grampos, pinos industriais, prego eletro-soldados e distribuição de ferramentas de fixação pneumáticas.

A marca AIRFIX é há mais de uma década reconhecida como uma das marcas mais lembradas no setor moveleiro e na cadeia da madeira.

Possuímos um parque industrial de mais de 4.000 metros quadrados (em uma área de 11.000 m2) e capacidade instalada de produção de 600 toneladas mensais. Nosso foco principal é atender as seguintes indústrias: móveis, estofados, embalagens, colchões, construção civil e estofados automotivos.

Na gestão de recursos humanos, a Tecnofast possui alta de promoção e integração de seus colaboradores: 90% dos colaboradores recomendam a Tecnofast como um local de trabalho e 92% consideram a comunicação com os colegas como excelente.

Garantir a entrega da produção programada pelo PCP dentro dos padrões segurança, qualidade e custo. Sugerir e, eventualmente acompanhar a execução por outros de pequenos projetos de melhoria em equipamentos existentes na produção de pregos. Auxiliar, pela sua experiência, os demais operadores no treinamento e resolução de problemas do dia a dia.

Competências:
Comunicação oral e escrita; Colaboração; Criatividade; Resolução de problemas; Proatividade; Resiliência.

Conhecimento:

Mecânica e elétrica de máquinas; Manutenção corretiva e preventiva; Uso de formulários, planilhas e gráficos; Controle de estoques e projeção de uso.

Habilidades:
Relacionamento interpessoal; Resolução de conflitos; Trabalho em equipe;

Vagas Abertas para Diversas Oportunidades

Você está em busca de uma nova oportunidade de carreira? Quer fazer parte de uma empresa em pleno crescimento? Então, essa é a sua chance!

Estamos em fase de expansão e buscando pessoas talentosas e motivadas para integrar nosso time.

  • Proatividade e dinamismo são essenciais;
  • Boa comunicação e simpatia são fundamentais.

  • Conferência e fechamento de caixa;
  • Responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes são cruciais.

  • Apoio nas operações de loja;
  • Reposição de produtos;

  • Agilidade e disposição para trabalho em equipe são necessárias.

Indústria - Operador de Produção:

  • Realizar atividades de produção;
  • Atuar em diversas etapas do processo industrial, como abastecer as máquinas com a matéria-prima, separar as peças para a montagem, conferir o funcionamento das máquinas, embalar os produtos, realizar a limpeza e manutenção das instalações e atender a outras demandas de produção;
